headline: CrowdStrike Is in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
author: Ryan Gould and David Carnevali

paragraphs.text: Fri, November 20, 2026 at 2:05 PM MST 1 min read

(Bloomberg) -- CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector and create a company with a combined market value of about $265 billion.
The two companies are discussing a potential combination that could come together soon, the people said, asking not to be identified because the information is confidential.
Deliberations are ongoing and there's no certainty they'll result in a transaction, the people said. Representatives for CrowdStrike and Zscaler didn't immediately respond to requests for comment.
Zscaler makes software that helps businesses protect against online threats. Its shares have dropped 13% this year, giving it a market value of $32 billion.

CrowdStrike, one of the cybersecurity industry's most valuable companies, has a market capitalization of around $233 billion. Through its core Falcon product, it specializes in endpoint security, or protecting individual devices like laptops and servers.
